label: Loan allowance / gross loans (%)
definition: allowance_grossloans_pct = 100 * customer-loan allowance / gross customer loans

label: NPL amount / gross loans (%)
definition: NPL_ratio_pct = 100 * regulatory NPL amount / matched gross loans

label: Broad NPL coverage (%)
definition: broad_NPL_coverage_pct = 100 * total customer-loan allowance / NPL amount (not NPL-specific)
